entities.name: sign regulations
entities.description: Regulations governing the installation, size, placement, and types of signs permitted within the city, including amendments to Article 11, Section 11-107, to apply regulations to signs related to real estate sales, leases, or rentals across all use districts.

entities.name: business community
entities.description: The network of local businesses, including chambers of commerce and business improvement districts, that contribute to the economic vitality of the city and provide input on policies affecting commercial activities.

entities.name: property signage
entities.description: Signs related to individual properties, including real estate signs for sale, lease, or rental, and regulations affecting their size, placement, and visibility in various districts.

entities.name: MLS and LoopNet usage
entities.description: The use of Multiple Listing Service (MLS) and LoopNet platforms for marketing and listing commercial and residential properties, including best practices and regulations.

entities.name: DBPR requirements
entities.description: Regulations and requirements set by the Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation (DBPR) for real estate professionals, including licensing, conduct, and compliance standards.
